attributes.action: We the Men & Women of the UK demand a new General election be held ASAP
attributes.additional_details: We demand a new General election be held for we the people need a say in who governs us. The manifestos are never fulfilled & we are treated with utter contempt. Illegal immigration is out of control. Our borders are wide open & we don't know who is in the UK. Put God First & end the culture of death. We believe Life Is From Conception No Exceptions Until A Natural Death. We believe every Life is Worth Living & a Civilised Society offers Families Palliative Care Hope, Love, Kindness not death
attributes.background: We the Men & Women of the UK have been treated appallingly by the current UK government, our lives have become worse and not better. We are over taxed, our pensioners are also being taxed and denied winter fuel payment etc. The cost of living is sky high. Nothing works efficiently.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
